default/31615.htm.text: Hermit: May the blessing of Eva be with you always... Are you my successor? Oh, when will my vigil end... I'm so tired...

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/3-01.htm.text: Hermit: I've been expecting you. You follow in the footsteps of giants! I've been waiting for many, many years... Since the gods told me to expect a hero such as you! I have the stone of vision you seek. First, however, you must prove that you are who you appear to be... Will you take a test?

links.text: Yes, I will take the test.
